verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a built-in AI palette (cmd+j) with preset prompts such as 'list key takeaways', free-form asks and saved custom prompts. It also offers a 'chat' with notes after you apply search filters, which grounds answers in your notes and scopes what the AI sees. A model toggle and a claim that notes marked private are excluded from AI add data controls. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality and grounding, detailed documentation of what data is sent to the AI providers, and consistent first-party detail on the private-note exclusion and source-linked answers (these claims come from a homepage whose description of the product conflicts with other docs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a built-in AI assistant can answer questions, summarize, and draft grounded in my own notes — with clear controls over what data it sees

citations.quote: After applying any desired filters to the search, you can also “chat” with those specific notes to ask questions and extract information.
You can select from one of our dozen or so prompts, like ‘list key takeaways’ or ‘list action-items’.
You can also ask the AI palette anything you’d like using the open text field, and save it as a custom prompt to quickly call on again later.
Notes marked private are excluded from AI note
Ask your notes. Answers linked to source notes.
